experiment: One frozen admission-gate replay on run08 baseline and isolate outputs, using exact cached visual context whenever available; fresh local OCR only for cache misses.
scope: development only; all24pages and old17hard cases already inspected; no threshold search and no expanded data
visual_evidence: Unmasked source context must repeat numeral at source location and agree on surrounding lexical anchors and reference format. Units/isotopes abstain.
context_definition: For both baseline and isolated rendering, context is anchored on unchanged parent raw proposal box, not the foreground-only trimmed rendering box. Isolate parent is run08 new_proposals[index].raw_box, chosen without gold. This keeps frozen context geometry and permits exact cache reuse.
cache_match: same source-image SHA256, same context xywh/dimensions, exact rendered context pixels, same recognition engine/settings; never reuse merely nearby context

acceptance.correct_net_gain: gated isolate correct additions >10, using the original ungated baseline; figure footnotes counted separately as before
acceptance.secondary_comparator: same frozen gate on baseline, reported for diagnosis only; cannot replace primary baseline
acceptance.decision: If any criterion fails, close and suspend automatic insertion; output candidates for human review only. No new confirmation set.
acceptance.no_population_safety_claim: Zero observed errors is not an error-rate guarantee.
